summary: Frontend-only verification of new WhatsApp founder links on Home + About (desktop 1920 & mobile 390). All 4 links point to correct wa.me numbers with correctly personalized decoded messages, target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer. Regression flows on Contact + project detail Availability Enquiry preserved. Zero pageerrors on home, about, contact, and a project detail page.

design_issues.screen: Home (mobile 390x844) — founders teaser MESSAGE SAI / MESSAGE AKHIL links
issues: Tap target height is only ~15px (10px uppercase text, no extra padding). Width is comfortable (130-148px), but the vertical hit area is below the commonly recommended 24px minimum. About-page equivalents are 40px tall and fine. Consider adding py-2 (or increasing line-height / vertical padding) on the Home teaser variant only. Non-blocking — link is still tappable — but flagged since the spec explicitly asked to verify 'adequate tap target' on mobile.

verification_details.founder-sai-whatsapp: href=https://wa.me/917780429845?text=Hello%20Sai%2C%20... target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer, positioned after bio (y=1671 vs last bio para y=1616)
verification_details.contact_whatsapp-chat-link: Uses 917780429845 with WHATSAPP_GREETING ('Hello My Dream Projects, I’m interested in knowing more about your residential projects in Ameenpur.') — unchanged

action_items: Optional: Increase mobile tap-target height for home-founder-sai-whatsapp / home-founder-akhil-whatsapp (currently ~15px tall) — e.g. add py-2 or block+min-h.
critical_code_review_comments: Both About.jsx and Home.jsx duplicate the exact same personalized WhatsApp message template inline. Consider extracting into contact.js (e.g., founderIntroMessage(firstName)) for DRY.

About.jsx line 227 uses class 'group' on the outer profile card and again 'group' on the link element — the inner ArrowUpRight animates via 'group-hover' which will also fire on hovering elsewhere on the card (bio, paragraphs). Consider using a named group (e.g., 'group/link' as done in Home.jsx) for tighter hover scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 founder WhatsApp links verified end-to-end (both viewports). Only nuance is home-mobile tap-target height (15px). Regressions on contact page + project detail availability-enquiry link confirmed intact.
